Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NimbusBank's payments platform team (me + Chen in APAC) is keen to see Redwood's hosted inference flow and regional routing capabilities. We're aiming for a 45-minute demo during the week of March 23 if that works for your team.

High-level requests:
- Short 10-min walkthrough of model routing and failover.
- 25-min demo of a live chat use case (multi-region participants).
- 10-min Q&A with our security lead (may join if timing aligns).

Proposed slots in CET (we're in Frankfurt):
- Tue, Mar 24 — 10:00 CET (that should be 05:00 EDT / 02:00 PDT?)
- Wed, Mar 25 — 14:00 CET (09:00 EDT / 06:00 PDT)

Note: I'm aware the US shifts clocks on Mar 8 but EU changes later in March — could we confirm who you're planning for (US east, west, or global)? We want to avoid a mismatch where our APAC teammate sees the wrong time.

I've attached a short agenda. If you'd prefer an APAC-friendly slot, Chen can propose times.

Thanks,
Sam

Thanks Sam — great to see interest from the payments team. Quick context up front: Redwood US already observed DST on Mar 8, so offsets between US/EU will be different for a few weeks until Europe moves clocks later in March. To avoid confusion I recommend scheduling using explicit time zones (e.g., CET / EDT) and offering a fallback plan.

Options we can support (all 45 minutes, recorded):
- Option A (APAC-first): Mar 24 06:00 PDT / 09:00 EDT / 14:00 CET (good for US/EU overlap; early for APAC)
- Option B (US-friendly): Mar 24 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT / 17:00 CET (better for US west; later for EU)
- Option C (APAC live): Mar 25 23:00 PDT / Mar 26 02:00 EDT / Mar 26 07:00 CET / Mar 26 15:00 HKT (we can do a late APAC slot and record for US)

Fallback plan (if timezone confusion persists):
- Book two short slots: one US/EU overlap (Option A or B) and one APAC-friendly Q&A (Option C) for Chen. We'll record the main walkthrough and run live Q&A for region-specific questions.

I've attached a small matrix that maps the above to regional offsets (Redwood_Regional_ClockMatrix.csv) and included a draft calendar invite (.ics). If you confirm preferred option and who will join from Nimbus (security lead or engineering), I'll lock the invites.
